scientific.integrity: The counterexample is obtained by solving the published two-step SWATS recurrence exactly. The construction forces two identical projection estimates, so the bias-corrected monitor satisfies the source trigger with zero discrepancy while the selected SGD rate lies beyond the scalar quadratic stability boundary.
limitations: The theorem uses the source-supported no-first-moment case beta1 = 0 rather than the experimental default beta1 = 0.9.
It is a deterministic scalar quadratic counterexample, not a claim about typical neural-network training.
The result diagnoses the switch criterion; it does not assess SWATS generalization.

title: Exact false-safe switchover family for SWATS on a scalar quadratic
